## File: facebookresearch_map-anything/mapanything/models/external/dinov2/models/vision_transformer.py

Prompts

```
['build a ViT-small vision transformer model with 384 embedding dim and 12 layers using MemEffAttention', 'build a ViT-base vision transformer model with 768 embedding dim and 12 layers using MemEffAttention', 'build a ViT-large vision transformer model with 1024 embedding dim and 24 layers using MemEffAttention', 'build a ViT-giant2 vision transformer model with 1536 embedding dim and 40 layers using MemEffAttention', 'extract intermediate feature maps from DinoVisionTransformer blocks with optional reshaping and class token return']
```

Usage

```
{'build_vit_small': 'build a ViT-small vision transformer model with 384 embedding dim and 12 layers using MemEffAttention', 'build_vit_base': 'build a ViT-base vision transformer model with 768 embedding dim and 12 layers using MemEffAttention', 'build_vit_large': 'build a ViT-large vision transformer model with 1024 embedding dim and 24 layers using MemEffAttention', 'build_vit_giant2': 'build a ViT-giant2 vision transformer model with 1536 embedding dim and 40 layers using MemEffAttention', 'extract_intermediate_layers': 'extract intermediate feature maps from DinoVisionTransformer blocks with optional reshaping and class token return'}
```
